name: Bishoujo
source:
You’re a special instructor at a girls’ school since you want to get a young girlfriend. However, the principal will be conducting performance reviews in the near future and therefore chances are high you’ll be out of job soon. So it’s now or never!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/12/03/december-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
